summary: Well-designed test suite with comprehensive coverage of glob patterns, rule loading, label resolution, error handling, and end-to-end workflow execution. Strengths: excellent test organization (Describe/Context/It structure), proper isolation using TestDrive and throwaway git repos, parametrized testing, sophisticated act integration with ANSI color stripping, and verification of exact output values. Rigorous edge case testing (empty inputs, conflict resolution via Stop flag, deduplication, priority ordering). Weakness: priority-ordering tests could cover tie-breaking scenarios more thoroughly; suite assumes implementation provides expected module API (Test-LabelGlob, Import-PrLabelRule, Get-PrLabel, etc.) and supporting config/fixture files exist. The 'Referenced files exist' test is well-conceived but would catch incomplete submission. Would catch most regressions if implementation matches the test contract.
